about: Figma connections, read on Nov 16 and 17 2026 from public Adobe pages: Integrate AEM Assets with Figma and its Experience League support article, the Figma plugin for GenStudio for Performance Marketing and GenStudio Photoshop (Experience League), Import Figma designs into Adobe Express and Adobe's pages on Express add-on access (Adobe Help), and Adobe Firefly help on the Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin for Figma and on custom models. Every quote was checked word for word against its page on Nov 17 2026, read with a plain fetch. Each connection keeps the quote on its source page and the references behind it. Hours are our own estimates; Adobe publishes none. The four lines are native, like Figma + Brand Intelligence and Adobe Asset Link: AEM Assets, GenStudio for Performance Marketing and Firefly Custom Models use Adobe's plugins in Figma (Adobe calls the AEM one the official connector, and the GenStudio and Firefly pages link the same Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin in the Figma Community), and the Figma add-on in Express is documented in Adobe's Express help and release notes. No Adobe page read names who publishes the Figma add-on in Express.

connections.how: Adobe's AEM Assets Connector opens as a panel in Figma. Designers search AEM Assets, place images, videos, GIFs and SVGs on the Figma canvas, bring in newer versions with Check for updates, and upload a selected item or a whole page to an AEM Assets folder.

how_evidence.quote: Ensure you are using the official Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets Connector from the Figma Community Marketplace.
The integration is native, requiring no third-party connectors beyond the Adobe Experience Manager AEM Assets Connector available on the Figma community.
On your Figma home page, click Actions from the toolbar at the bottom of the canvas and search for Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets Connector in the search bar available in the dialog box.

Alternatively, access the Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets Connector available on Figma community, click Open in…, select a recent file or create a new file and click Run to access the Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets Connector panel.
Search for the asset using Content Advisor within the connector panel.
For importing AEM assets into Figma, the supported formats are image assets (JPEG, PNG), video files (MP4, MOV, WebM), Animated files (GIF), and Vector files (SVG).

The assets used in the current Figma document are compared to the assets that exist in AEM. Any updates are listed in a separate window. Click Update to get the updated asset from AEM into your Figma document.

In the dialog box, select either Selected Item or Page, specify a file or page name, define an export configuration and click Upload to upload the selected asset or the entire design to the destination folder.

connections.how: Adobe's Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin adds a GenStudio for Performance Marketing panel to Figma. Designers map the text and image layers of their ad templates to GenStudio fields, generate up to eight on-brand Meta, LinkedIn or Display variations from a brand, persona, product and prompt, translate them, and export them to GenStudio for Performance Marketing as experiences. The plugin also converts Figma frames to Photoshop documents for use with GenStudio Photoshop.

how_evidence.quote: You'll find the Adobe Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin in the Figma marketplace, where it's available like any other plugin.
Open the Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio plugin in Figma and click the Export tab in the plugin UI.
The GenStudio for Performance Marketing Figma plugin adds a new panel to the Figma application that lets you generate on-brand content.
Map Figma text elements to GenStudio for Performance Marketing fields, such as headline, body, on_image_text, and more.
You must map an image by assigning the image field role to at least one image element in your template.
Generate new on-brand Meta, LinkedIn, or Display ad Experiences based on a brand, persona, product, and text prompt.
Select the number of variations to be produced (up to eight).
Select the Brand, Persona, and Product to use for the content generation.
Translate generated Experiences into multiple languages.
Export generated Experiences to GenStudio for Performance Marketing.
You can use the Figma plugin to convert a Figma frame, multiple frames, or an entire document to Photoshop format and export it for use with GenStudio Photoshop.

connections.how: The Figma add-on in Adobe Express connects the user's Figma account and imports a page, frame or layer from a Figma file, as editable Express elements (Native Import) or a flattened image (Rasterize). Gradients, patterns and certain masked or combined shapes can come in as images, and a font Express lacks gets a fallback. The add-on does not change the Figma file.

how_evidence.quote: Open the Figma add-on and select Connect.
Return to Adobe Express, paste the URL in the URL link field, and then select Continue.
Select the page, frame, or layer you want to import.
Native Import: Imports supported content as editable Adobe Express elements.
Rasterize: Imports the selected content as a flattened image. You can move and scale the image, but you can't edit its individual elements.
Gradients, patterns, and certain masked or combined shapes can be imported as images to preserve their appearance.

The add-on matches fonts by name when the same font is available in Figma and Adobe Express. If a font isn't available in Adobe Express, a fallback font is applied and identified as Font Not Available in the import summary.
The add-on has read-only access to Figma files and doesn't modify the original file.

notes: Every service starts off (default false), as XK16 does, so a canvas saved before Nov 17 reopens with the same services and totals.

XF01 is the connector for Figma designers: the folders they reach and the Figma side, tested end to end. DAM onboarding, users and access (AS01) sets up the Admin Console users, groups and product profiles for AEM Assets as a whole.
XF02 decides where designs uploaded from Figma land and with which export settings. The folder hierarchy, tags and metadata forms are AS02; the save-back of Express designs is XJ03.

XF03 builds and maps Figma ad files for the plugin. GS03 codes responsive HTML templates in GenStudio, XJ10 builds Express templates for GenStudio, and GS05 trains editors on GenStudio itself. Adobe's integrations page calls Express templates in GenStudio the recommended approach for ad templates, so this connection is for clients whose designers already work in Figma; the card says so with its first prerequisite and no hedge.

XF04 converts Figma frames for GenStudio Photoshop, which needs Photoshop 25.6.0 or later and installs from Adobe Exchange (its Experience League page); that is XF04's own note, so the card's prerequisites do not repeat it. XJ12 brings Photoshop and Illustrator files into Express, the other direction and another app.

XF05 brings Figma designs into Express, fixes what the import changes and hands the designs over for templates: shared templates with locked elements are EP03, and Express templates for GenStudio are XJ10.

XF06 works with the custom models each designer has created, the route Adobe's Figma page documents: it checks the plugin and Firefly access, generates with each designer and walks them through Text to image. It does not train, publish or share models (FM02, FM03, FM05) or write the prompt guide (FM04), which XK09 (Express) and XK10 (Creative Cloud apps) repeat.
Adobe's Express add-ons overview says add-ons allow connections to third-party tools, and its listing of the Figma add-on could not be opened; no Adobe page read names the Figma add-on's publisher.

Adobe's Figma page says to choose a custom model you've created. Only the Firefly web page adds models shared with you, and the share page says a Generator generates in Creative Cloud apps, so the card and XF06 promise only the models a designer has created.

GenStudio for Performance Marketing and Firefly Custom Models work through one plugin, listed in the Figma marketplace as Firefly Enterprise and GenStudio (Adobe's Firefly help and the GenStudio page both name it), so both cards use that name and a partner plans one install.

Left out for lack of an Adobe page: Express designs into Figma, and Figma with Creative Cloud apps, Frame.io or Firefly Creative Production. Workfront Fusion's Figma modules, AEM's Figma to Visual Content Fragments skill and Brand Intelligence's BN06 are other routes, not built here.
